scope: Read-only source/containment/arithmetic review and saved fixture evidence; reviewer did not execute verification, extraction, tests, models, GPU or WSL.
fixture_execution_attribution: Author executed same frozen source with D:/AI/Trellis2AMD/venv/Scripts/python.exe; two positive split cases, six negative geometry cases and edge-run boundary fixture passed. Reviewer did not rerun.

approved_route.entry: Verifier own default Windows host, which launches its own --worker and sends exact GO plus EOF after Job attachment.
approved_route.execution_control: Root alone authorises and executes this CPU readback. No automatic retry.
approved_route.unsupported_unused_route: Do not use mesh_host.py --verify: it would nest a subprocess host beneath the outer audit guard after consuming GO. Executed extraction harness is retained unchanged; that unused route is outside clearance.
approved_route.runtime_note: Use the same installed AMD Python executable as the saved fixtures, with NumPy/psutil available; the bundled Python dependency probe did not qualify because psutil was unavailable. No installation or environment write is needed.

source_witnesses: All ten genuine input tensors, payload hashes, profile/contract/source-job binding, strict C2S chain and exact original initial coordinates are read. Both NPY outputs and PLY are reopened read-only. Independent F32 vertex formula/order, paired source triangle splits/winding, positive flag, four actual coordinate corners, F32 split-weight products/ties and increasing original anchor/axis order are checked. Batched omitted-flag membership queries prove no valid source quad was omitted. No call constructs or re-extracts faces, and no geometry is changed.

memory.scope: Whole edge key array is retained and sorted in place; incidence run counts use bounded batches with cross-batch carry. No whole starts/counts arrays. Maximum face key N^3-1 and edge key N^2-1 fit signed 64-bit. No claim whole process fits 2GiB or exact library workspaces is made.

containment.memory_scope: Windows Job continuously enforces the 6GiB per-process committed cap; it is not an RSS/file-map ceiling. Initial 12GiB/2GiB resource gates are explicit and are not described as live polling.
containment.gate: Worker reads exact GO plus EOF before NumPy/artifact I/O; parent attaches existing non-breakaway KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE Job before GO.
containment.CPU_guard: Model/GPU imports, further subprocess and network calls are denied. Single-thread BLAS/OpenMP environment and bytecode-disabled Python are retained.
containment.failure: Worker/error/timeout/forced or unverified cleanup cannot PASS; receipts/logs use exclusive creation and no retries.

acceptance: Fourteen read-only maps close in finally. Before/after hashes, sizes, mtimes, file IDs and single-link/plain ancestry checks protect neural source, sidecars, original coordinate input and all four mesh files. Complete NPY/PLY index/float equality, nondegenerate/nonduplicate faces, original source witnesses and metadata agreement are mandatory. Edge incidence is diagnostic, with no topology repair.
limits: PASS from this verifier establishes saved geometry readback/source correspondence, not watertightness, outward orientation, connectedness, self-intersection absence or visual fidelity.
No re-extraction, mesh edits, material/texture work, GLB conversion, model forward, GPU/WSL work or frontend generation is covered.
decision: CLEAR for root to run the exact direct CPU verifier host once under its existing resource, deadline, ownership and immutability guards.
